verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no first-party AI feature in Obsidian that generates insights or suggestions from a user's notes. The only AI mentions are third-party community plugins (Text-Generator, Copilot), and one user explicitly notes there is 'no decent RAG functionality'. Community plugins are ecosystem add-ons and a user-side workaround, not the product's own capability, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
